stem: Which statement would MOST LIKELY have been said by someone who immigrated to the United States from China in the mid-1800s?

options.label: A
options.text: “I fled famine in my homeland only to find difficult conditions in the United States. I settled in Boston, but I found it difficult to find work because people discriminated against me for my religion and ethnicity.”

options.label: B
options.text: “I left my homeland because of political unrest there. I settled in Wisconsin, because the land there reminded me of home. I now have a successful farm.”

options.label: C
options.text: “I left my homeland to avoid harsh rule by the king who claimed my land. I settled in the Carolina backcountry with other members of my clan. We’ve built log cabins, and I make my living as a craftsman.”

options.label: D
options.text: “I left my homeland because I was inspired by stories of gold in California. When I didn’t find gold, I got a job helping build the railroad. I faced a lot of discrimination.”
